'''Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!''' (Japanese: '''ポケットモンスターダイヤモンド・パール物語 ポケモンD・P''' ''Pocket Monsters Diamond-Pearl Legend: Pokémon DP'', often shortened to '''ポケモンD・P''' ''Pokémon DP'') is a [[Pokémon manga]] based on [[Pokémon Diamond and Pearl]].

The story follows [[Hareta]] on his quest from [[Professor Rowan]] to find the [[Legendary Pokémon]] {{p|Dialga}}. He is joined on this journey by [[Mitsumi]], Professor Rowan's assistant, and occasionally, {{OBP|Jun|DPA}}, a roaming Pokémon Trainer smitten by Mitsumi's beauty. Along the way, this group runs into [[Team Galactic]] and their plans.

This series is written by [[Shigekatsu Ihara]], the author of [[Pokémon Battle Frontier]].

==English translations==
All eight volumes of the Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure! manga were translated by [[VIZ Media]]. The volumes are currently available in print individually or in a [[Manga boxed sets#Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!|boxed set]], as well as digitally via the Nook eBook stores and formerly Viz Media's Perfect Square app and Amazon Kindle.

VIZ Media's translation was licensed by [[Chuang Yi]], who published all eight volumes in their region.

==International translations==
In {{pmin|Taiwan}} and {{pmin|Hong Kong}}, Ching Win translates the manga to Traditional Chinese as {{tt|神奇寶貝鑽石·珍珠篇|Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl Saga}} and {{tt|寵物小精靈鑽石·珍珠篇|Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl Saga}}, respectively.

In {{pmin|Thailand}}, Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure! is translated by Bongkoch Comic with the title '''{{tt|โปเกมอน DP|Pokémon DP}}'''. All eight volumes of the manga have been translated into Thai.
